# Implement side projects management in admin (2025-11-14 04:18Z)

_**User (2025-11-13 02:31Z)**_

On the frontend we have our side-projects.html file that we have a "Projects" section. It is just static text that I have entered.

I would like to add this to our backend `admin/` section where we can manage it like we do the Portfolio, Documents and related.

On my Admin Sidebar Panel we can edit the "Projects" placeholder below "References" and replace the "coming soon" with something with more meaning.

We can create a sqlite database like we did with `documents` and `portfolios` where it would be a database just for the projects and we can put it all in a sub folder called `side-projects` for the template files and etc, but we will have it managed or added ot the sidebar in the `admin/` folder.

We currently have 5 Categories, but we can set this up to be able to manage the Project Categories from the admin panel as well, let it use a Grid Listing page with paginations.

We will have a simple grid listing with paginations of all the projects, where it is full width and responsive to the different browser options out there. We will also use these columns as apart of the grid listing.

- Title Name

- Category

- Posted Date

- Date Revised

Then when we click to edit one of the projects it wil be a basic form with all of the fields that are needed for the attached screenshot images.

Then we will re-create the side-projects.html file so that it is a tailwind css / alpinejs styled setup.

If this makes sense, feel free to start, otherwise ask any questions you have so that we can make sure this is done correctly.



Be aware in our admin panel we have a section called "Portfolio" which differs from our Side Projects. On the frontend if you review the `side-projects.html` file you can see the structure of it, along with the attached screenshots.



We are going to create a new section called `side-projects`. Also the "Categories for this differ from the Portfolio as well, so please do not confuse the Porttfolios with the Side Projects.

```diff
+ PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
+ 
+ -- Side Project Categories (Development, SysOps, Hobbies, Electrical, DIY, etc.)
+ CREATE TABLE side_project_categories (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   code            TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,   -- e.g., &quot;development&quot;, &quot;sysops&quot;, &quot;hobbies&quot;
+   label           TEXT NOT NULL,          -- display name
+   description     TEXT,
+   color           TEXT,                   -- color code for UI (e.g., &quot;blue&quot;, &quot;red&quot;, &quot;green&quot;)
+   icon            TEXT,                   -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+   created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+   updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ -- Seed initial categories
+ INSERT INTO side_project_categories (code, label, description, color, icon, display_order) VALUES
+ (&#39;development&#39;, &#39;Development&#39;, &#39;Software development projects&#39;, &#39;blue&#39;, &#39;fas fa-code&#39;, 1),
+ (&#39;sysops&#39;, &#39;SysOps&#39;, &#39;System operations and infrastructure projects&#39;, &#39;red&#39;, &#39;fas fa-cogs&#39;, 2),
+ (&#39;hobbies&#39;, &#39;Hobbies&#39;, &#39;Personal hobby projects&#39;, &#39;green&#39;, &#39;fas fa-leaf&#39;, 3),
+ (&#39;electrical&#39;, &#39;Electrical&#39;, &#39;Electrical and home automation projects&#39;, &#39;yellow&#39;, &#39;fas fa-bolt&#39;, 4),
+ (&#39;diy&#39;, &#39;DIY&#39;, &#39;Do-it-yourself projects&#39;, &#39;purple&#39;, &#39;fas fa-tools&#39;, 5);
+ 
+ -- Side Projects table
+ CREATE TABLE side_projects (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   category_id     INTEGER REFERENCES side_project_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
+   
+   title           TEXT NOT NULL,
+   slug            TEXT UNIQUE,
+   
+   description     TEXT,                  -- main description
+   
+   status          TEXT DEFAULT &#39;in development&#39;,  -- active, in development, backlog, archived, brainstorming
+   metrics         TEXT,                  -- e.g., &quot;Multi-platform&quot;, &quot;50+ Scripts&quot;, &quot;Enterprise-grade&quot;
+   
+   posted_date     TEXT,                  -- when project was first posted
+   revised_date    TEXT,                  -- when project was last revised/updated
+   
+   -- Project statistics (stored as JSON)
+   stats           TEXT,                  -- JSON object with stats like {platforms: &quot;3&quot;, features: &quot;25+&quot;}
+   
+   created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+   updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ -- Technologies used in projects (many-to-many)
+ CREATE TABLE side_project_technologies (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   project_id      INTEGER REFERENCES side_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   name            TEXT NOT NULL,
+   icon            TEXT,                  -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Features of projects (many-to-many)
+ CREATE TABLE side_project_features (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   project_id      INTEGER REFERENCES side_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   name            TEXT NOT NULL,
+   description     TEXT,
+   icon            TEXT,                  -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Technical details for projects
+ CREATE TABLE side_project_technical_details (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   project_id      INTEGER REFERENCES side_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   title           TEXT NOT NULL,
+   description     TEXT NOT NULL,
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Gallery images for projects
+ CREATE TABLE side_project_images (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   project_id      INTEGER REFERENCES side_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   url             TEXT NOT NULL,         -- e.g., &quot;/assets/images/projects/...&quot;
+   alt             TEXT,
+   width           INTEGER,
+   height          INTEGER,
+   is_cover        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Indexes
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_projects_category ON side_projects(category_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_projects_slug ON side_projects(slug);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_projects_status ON side_projects(status);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_projects_posted_date ON side_projects(posted_date);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_projects_revised_date ON side_projects(revised_date);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_project_technologies_project ON side_project_technologies(project_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_project_features_project ON side_project_features(project_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_project_technical_details_project ON side_project_technical_details(project_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_project_images_project ON side_project_images(project_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_side_project_categories_display_order ON side_project_categories(display_order);
+ 
```

```diff
+ # ============================================================================
+ # Side Projects System Routes
+ # ============================================================================
+ 
+ def side_project_slugify(value: str) -&gt; str:
+     cleaned = &quot;&quot;.join(char if char.isalnum() else &quot;-&quot; for char in value.strip().lower())
+     while &quot;--&quot; in cleaned:
+         cleaned = cleaned.replace(&quot;--&quot;, &quot;-&quot;)
+     return cleaned.strip(&quot;-&quot;)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/admin/side-projects&quot;)
+ def side_projects_list(request: Request) -&gt; Any:
+     try:
+         with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+             projects = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT 
+                     sp.*,
+                     c.label AS category_label,
+                     c.code AS category_code,
+                     c.color AS category_color
+                 FROM side_projects sp
+                 LEFT JOIN side_project_categories c ON c.id = sp.category_id
+                 ORDER BY sp.revised_date DESC, sp.posted_date DESC, sp.id DESC
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+     except Exception:
+         projects = []
+     return templates.TemplateResponse(
+         &quot;side-projects/side_projects_list.html&quot;,
+         {&quot;request&quot;: request, &quot;projects&quot;: projects},
+     )
+ 
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/admin/side-projects/categories&quot;)

+     try:
+         with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+             categories = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT 
+                     c.*,
+                     COUNT(sp.id) AS project_count

+                 LEFT JOIN side_projects sp ON sp.category_id = c.id
+                 GROUP BY c.id
+                 ORDER BY c.display_order, c.label
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()

+         categories = []

+         features = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT * FROM side_project_features 
+             WHERE project_id = ? 
+             ORDER BY display_order, name
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id,)).fetchall()
+         
+         technical_details = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT * FROM side_project_technical_details 
+             WHERE project_id = ? 
+             ORDER BY display_order, title
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id,)).fetchall()
+         
+         images = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT * FROM side_project_images 
+             WHERE project_id = ? 
+             ORDER BY display_order, id
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id,)).fetchall()
+     
+     return templates.TemplateResponse(
+         &quot;side-projects/side_project_edit.html&quot;,
+         {
+             &quot;request&quot;: request,
+             &quot;project&quot;: project,
+             &quot;categories&quot;: categories,
+             &quot;technologies&quot;: technologies,
+             &quot;features&quot;: features,
+             &quot;technical_details&quot;: technical_details,
+             &quot;images&quot;: images,
+         },
+     )
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/side-projects/save&quot;)
+ def side_project_save(
+     request: Request,
+     project_id: str | None = Form(None),
+     title: str = Form(...),
+     slug: str | None = Form(None),
+     category_id: str | None = Form(None),
+     description: str | None = Form(None),
+     status: str = Form(&quot;in development&quot;),
+     metrics: str | None = Form(None),
+     posted_date: str | None = Form(None),
+     revised_date: str | None = Form(None),
+     stats: str | None = Form(None),
+     technologies: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+     technology_icons: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+     features: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+     feature_descriptions: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+     feature_icons: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+     technical_detail_titles: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+     technical_detail_descriptions: list[str] | None = Form(None),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     today = date.today().isoformat()
+     
+     if not slug:
+         slug = side_project_slugify(title)
+     
+     category_id_val = _optional_int(category_id)
+     
+     stats_json = None
+     if stats:
+         try:
+             stats_json = json.dumps(json.loads(stats))
+         except json.JSONDecodeError:
+             stats_json = None
+     
+     with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+         if not project_id or project_id == &quot;&quot;:
+             if not posted_date:
+                 posted_date = today
+             if not revised_date:
+                 revised_date = today
+             
+             cursor = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 INSERT INTO side_projects 
+                 (category_id, title, slug, description, status, metrics, posted_date, revised_date, stats)
+                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (
+                 category_id_val,
+                 title.strip(),
+                 slug,
+                 description.strip() if description else None,
+                 status,
+                 metrics.strip() if metrics else None,
+                 posted_date,
+                 revised_date,
+                 stats_json,
+             ))
+             project_id_int = cursor.lastrowid
+         else:
+             project_id_int = int(project_id)
+             if not revised_date:
+                 revised_date = today
+             
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 UPDATE side_projects 
+                 SET category_id = ?, title = ?, slug = ?, description = ?, status = ?, 
+                     metrics = ?, revised_date = ?, stats = ?
+                 WHERE id = ?
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (
+                 category_id_val,
+                 title.strip(),
+                 slug,
+                 description.strip() if description else None,
+                 status,
+                 metrics.strip() if metrics else None,
+                 revised_date,
+                 stats_json,
+                 project_id_int,
+             ))
+         
+         # Delete existing related records
+         conn.execute(&quot;DELETE FROM side_project_technologies WHERE project_id = ?&quot;, (project_id_int,))
+         conn.execute(&quot;DELETE FROM side_project_features WHERE project_id = ?&quot;, (project_id_int,))
+         conn.execute(&quot;DELETE FROM side_project_technical_details WHERE project_id = ?&quot;, (project_id_int,))
+         
+         # Insert technologies
+         if technologies:
+             for idx, tech_name in enumerate(technologies):
+                 if tech_name and tech_name.strip():
+                     tech_icon = &quot;&quot;
+                     if technology_icons and idx &lt; len(technology_icons):
+                         tech_icon = technology_icons[idx] or &quot;&quot;
+                     conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                         INSERT INTO side_project_technologies (project_id, name, icon, display_order)
+                         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
+                     &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id_int, tech_name.strip(), tech_icon.strip(), idx))
+         
+         # Insert features
+         if features:
+             for idx, feature_name in enumerate(features):
+                 if feature_name and feature_name.strip():
+                     feature_desc = &quot;&quot;
+                     feature_icon = &quot;&quot;
+                     if feature_descriptions and idx &lt; len(feature_descriptions):
+                         feature_desc = feature_descriptions[idx] or &quot;&quot;
+                     if feature_icons and idx &lt; len(feature_icons):
+                         feature_icon = feature_icons[idx] or &quot;&quot;
+                     conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                         INSERT INTO side_project_features (project_id, name, description, icon, display_order)
+                         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+                     &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id_int, feature_name.strip(), feature_desc.strip(), feature_icon.strip(), idx))
+         
+         # Insert technical details
+         if technical_detail_titles:
+             for idx, detail_title in enumerate(technical_detail_titles):
+                 if detail_title and detail_title.strip():
+                     detail_desc = &quot;&quot;
+                     if technical_detail_descriptions and idx &lt; len(technical_detail_descriptions):
+                         detail_desc = technical_detail_descriptions[idx] or &quot;&quot;
+                     conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                         INSERT INTO side_project_technical_details (project_id, title, description, display_order)
+                         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
+                     &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id_int, detail_title.strip(), detail_desc.strip(), idx))
+         
+         conn.commit()
+     
+     return RedirectResponse(url=f&quot;/admin/side-projects/{project_id_int}&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/side-projects/images/upload&quot;)
+ def side_project_image_upload(
+     project_id: int = Form(...),
+     file: UploadFile = File(...),
+     is_cover: bool = Form(False),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     if not file.filename:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=&quot;No file provided&quot;)
+     
+     ext = Path(file.filename).suffix.lower()
+     if ext not in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f&quot;Unsupported image format: {ext}&quot;)
+     
+     project_img_dir = SIDE_PROJECTS_IMG_ROOT / str(project_id)
+     project_img_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+     
+     safe_filename = secrets.token_urlsafe(8) + ext
+     file_path = project_img_dir / safe_filename
+     url = f&quot;/assets/images/projects/{project_id}/{safe_filename}&quot;
+     
+     with file_path.open(&quot;wb&quot;) as f:
+         content = file.file.read()
+         f.write(content)
+     
+     with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+         max_order = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) FROM side_project_images WHERE project_id = ?
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id,)).fetchone()[0]
+         
+         conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             INSERT INTO side_project_images (project_id, url, alt, is_cover, display_order)
+             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id, url, file.filename, 1 if is_cover else 0, max_order + 1))
+         conn.commit()
+     
+     return RedirectResponse(url=f&quot;/admin/side-projects/{project_id}&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/side-projects/categories/new&quot;)
+ def side_project_category_new(
+     code: str = Form(...),
+     label: str = Form(...),
+     description: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     color: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     icon: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     display_order: int = Form(0),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+         try:
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 INSERT INTO side_project_categories 
+                 (code, label, description, color, icon, display_order)
+                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (
+                 code.strip(),
+                 label.strip(),
+                 description.strip(),
+                 color.strip(),
+                 icon.strip(),
+                 display_order,
+             ))
+             conn.commit()
+         except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
+             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f&quot;Category code &#39;{code}&#39; already exists&quot;) from exc
+     return RedirectResponse(url=&quot;/admin/side-projects/categories&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/side-projects/categories/update&quot;)
+ def side_project_category_update(
+     category_id: str = Form(...),
+     code: str = Form(...),
+     label: str = Form(...),
+     description: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     color: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     icon: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     display_order: int = Form(0),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     pk = _optional_int(category_id)
+     if pk is None:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=&quot;Invalid category id.&quot;)
+     with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+         try:
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 UPDATE side_project_categories 
+                 SET code = ?, label = ?, description = ?, color = ?, icon = ?, display_order = ?
+                 WHERE id = ?
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (
+                 code.strip(),
+                 label.strip(),
+                 description.strip(),
+                 color.strip(),
+                 icon.strip(),
+                 display_order,
+                 pk,
+             ))
+             conn.commit()
+         except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
+             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f&quot;Category code &#39;{code}&#39; already exists&quot;) from exc
+     return RedirectResponse(url=&quot;/admin/side-projects/categories&quot;, status_code=303)
+
```

```diff
+             &lt;/a&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         {% endif %}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+ &lt;/div&gt;
+ {% endblock %}
+
```

```diff
+ def api_side_projects() -&gt; JSONResponse:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;API endpoint to fetch all side projects for frontend&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     try:
+         with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+             # Get categories
+             categories = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT id, code, label, color, icon, display_order
+                 FROM side_project_categories
+                 ORDER BY display_order, label
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             
+             # Get projects with category info
+             projects = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT 
+                     sp.*,
+                     c.code AS category_code,
+                     c.label AS category_label,
+                     c.color AS category_color,
+                     c.icon AS category_icon
+                 FROM side_projects sp
+                 LEFT JOIN side_project_categories c ON sp.category_id = c.id
+                 ORDER BY sp.revised_date DESC, sp.posted_date DESC, sp.id DESC
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             
+             # Build projects list with related data
+             projects_list = []
+             for project in projects:
+                 # Get technologies
+                 technologies = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT name, icon FROM side_project_technologies
+                     WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, name
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 
+                 # Get features
+                 features = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT name, description, icon FROM side_project_features
+                     WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, name
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 
+                 # Get technical details
+                 technical_details = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT title, description FROM side_project_technical_details
+                     WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, title
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 
+                 # Get images
+                 images = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT url, alt FROM side_project_images
+                     WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, id
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 
+                 # Parse stats JSON
+                 stats = {}
+                 if project[&quot;stats&quot;]:
+                     try:

+                 
+                 projects_list.append({

+                     &quot;status&quot;: project[&quot;status&quot;] or &quot;in development&quot;,
+                     &quot;lastUpdated&quot;: project[&quot;revised_date&quot;] or project[&quot;posted_date&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;description&quot;: project[&quot;description&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;metrics&quot;: project[&quot;metrics&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;technologies&quot;: [{&quot;name&quot;: t[&quot;name&quot;], &quot;icon&quot;: t[&quot;icon&quot;] or &quot;&quot;} for t in technologies],
+                     &quot;features&quot;: [{&quot;name&quot;: f[&quot;name&quot;], &quot;icon&quot;: f[&quot;icon&quot;] or &quot;&quot;, &quot;description&quot;: f[&quot;description&quot;] or &quot;&quot;} for f in features],
+                     &quot;technicalDetails&quot;: [{&quot;title&quot;: td[&quot;title&quot;], &quot;description&quot;: td[&quot;description&quot;]} for td in technical_details],
+                     &quot;stats&quot;: stats,
+                     &quot;gallery&quot;: [{&quot;url&quot;: img[&quot;url&quot;], &quot;alt&quot;: img[&quot;alt&quot;] or &quot;&quot;} for img in images]
+                 })
+             
+             # Group projects by category code
+             projects_by_category = {}
+             for project in projects_list:

+                 if cat_code not in projects_by_category:
+                     projects_by_category[cat_code] = []
+                 projects_by_category[cat_code].append(project)
+             
+             # Build categories list

+                 &quot;label&quot;: cat[&quot;label&quot;],
+                 &quot;color&quot;: cat[&quot;color&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;icon&quot;: cat[&quot;icon&quot;] or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;count&quot;: len(projects_by_category.get(cat[&quot;code&quot;], []))
+             } for cat in categories]
+         
+         return JSONResponse(content={

+         })
+     except Exception as e:
```

## Summary

Side Projects management system added to the admin panel.

### 1. Database structure
- Created `side-projects/` directory with SQLite database
- Schema includes:
  - `side_project_categories` (Development, SysOps, Hobbies, Electrical, DIY)
  - `side_projects` (main project table)
  - `side_project_technologies`, `side_project_features`, `side_project_technical_details`, `side_project_images` (related tables)

### 2. Admin panel routes
- `/admin/side-projects` — Grid listing with pagination
- `/admin/side-projects/new` — Create new project
- `/admin/side-projects/{id}` — Edit project
- `/admin/side-projects/categories` — Manage categories
- `/admin/side-projects/categories/{id}` — Edit category
- `/api/side-projects` — API endpoint for frontend

### 3. Admin templates
- `side_projects_list.html` — Grid listing (Title, Category, Posted Date, Date Revised)
- `side_project_edit.html` — Form with all fields (description, status, metrics, technologies, features, technical details, images, stats)
- `side_project_categories_list.html` — Category management
- `side_project_category_edit.html` — Category edit form

### 4. Sidebar update
- Replaced "Projects" placeholder with "Side Projects" section
- Added links to Side Projects and Categories

### 5. Frontend integration
- Updated `side-projects.html` to fetch data from `/api/side-projects`
- Dynamic category tabs based on database categories
- Projects load from the database instead of hardcoded data

### Features supported
- Title, Category, Status, Metrics
- Posted Date, Date Revised
- Description
- Technologies (with icons)
- Features (with icons and descriptions)
- Technical Details
- Project Statistics (JSON)
- Gallery Images

The system is ready to use. You can start managing side projects in the admin panel at `/admin/side-projects`.

The API structure matches the frontend. The JavaScript errors are fixed. Summary:

## Fixed JavaScript errors

The template now uses a JSON script tag to separate data from code, which resolves the linter errors. The JavaScript reads the data from the JSON script tag instead of embedding Jinja2 syntax directly.

## Data structure alignment

The API already outputs data in the format the frontend expects:

- `name` (not `title`) — API outputs `project["title"]` as `"name"`
- `category` — API outputs `category_label` as `"category"`
- `lastUpdated` — API outputs `revised_date` or `posted_date` as `"lastUpdated"`
- `status` — API outputs this correctly
- `description`, `metrics`, `technologies`, `features`, `technicalDetails`, `stats`, `gallery` — all match

## Category matching

The frontend checks for exact category strings: `'Development'`, `'SysOps'`, `'Hobbies'`, `'Electrical'`, `'DIY'`. The schema seed data matches these labels, so styling should work.

## Next steps

1. Create projects in the admin panel — they should display correctly on the frontend
2. The form now properly initializes with existing data when editing
3. All fields (technologies, features, technical details) can be added dynamically

The system should now work end-to-end. Create a test project in the admin panel and verify it appears correctly on the frontend.

```diff
+                     this.images.forEach(img =&gt; {

+                 });

+                 if (response.ok) {
```

## Summary

### Field mappings

1. **Technologies** = Blue tags below the description (e.g., "Tailwind CSS", "AlpineJS", "PostgreSQL")
   - These are the technology tags shown under the project description

2. **Features** = "Key Features" section in the detail view
   - Examples: "Multi-platform", "Task Management", "Time Tracking"
   - Each feature can have a name, icon, and optional description

3. **Technical Details** = "Technical Details" section
   - Examples: "Web Application: Laravel backend with Vue.js..."
   - Each detail has a title and description

### Project Statistics JSON format

You can format it across multiple lines for readability. Example:

```json
{
  "platforms": {
    "value": "3",
    "label": "Platforms"
  },
  "features": {
    "value": "25+",
    "label": "Features"
  },
  "stage": {
    "value": "Beta",
    "label": "Stage"
  },
  "sync": {
    "value": "Real-time",
    "label": "Sync"
  }
}
```

Or on one line:
```json
{"platforms": {"value": "3", "label": "Platforms"}, "features": {"value": "25+", "label": "Features"}}
```

Both formats work. The form includes an example you can expand.

### Image gallery features

1. Upload images with a "Set as Cover Image" checkbox
2. Gallery grid view with hover actions
3. Click any image to open a modal
4. Modal features:
   - Full-size image display
   - Left/right arrows to navigate
   - Image counter (e.g., "Image 1 of 5")
   - Editable description field
   - Cover image indicator
5. Delete images with confirmation
6. Set cover image — clicking the star button sets an image as cover and unsets others
7. Placeholder — uses the same SVG placeholder when no image is available (matches frontend)

### New routes added

- `/admin/side-projects/images/{image_id}/set-cover` — Set an image as cover
- `/admin/side-projects/images/{image_id}/delete` — Delete an image
- `/admin/side-projects/images/{image_id}/update` — Update image description

### Form improvements

- Field mapping guide — expandable section explaining what each field does
- Dynamic arrays — Technologies, Features, and Technical Details can be added dynamically
- Form sync — Alpine.js data syncs to form inputs before submission
- Better JSON formatting — Multi-line JSON support with example

The form is ready to use. You can create and edit side projects with all the features shown in your screenshots.

Fixed both issues:

## Fixed Issues:

### 1. **Duplication Problem**
- Removed `name` attributes from visible inputs (Technologies, Features, Technical Details)
- Only hidden inputs created by `syncFormData()` on form submit will be sent
- This prevents duplicate submissions

### 2. **Alpine.js Null Reference Errors**
- Added null checks in the `currentImage` getter
- Added `x-show="currentImage"` to the image info section so it only renders when an image is selected
- Added a null check in `updateImageDescription()` before updating

The form should now:
- Show each item only once (no duplication)
- Handle empty image galleries without errors
- Properly sync Alpine.js data to form inputs on submit

Try editing the project again; the duplication and console errors should be resolved.

Fixed both issues:

1. **Null reference error**: Changed the image description input from `x-model="currentImage.alt"` to `:value="currentImage ? currentImage.alt : ''"` with conditional `@input` and `@blur` handlers. This prevents accessing `alt` when `currentImage` is null.

2. **Delete buttons**: Added delete buttons for each entry in Technologies, Features, and Technical Details:
   - Added `removeTechnology()`, `removeFeature()`, and `removeTechnicalDetail()` methods
   - Each row now has a red delete button (trash icon) on the right
   - Updated the grid layout to accommodate the delete buttons

The delete buttons use a 12-column grid system:
- **Technologies**: 5 columns for name, 6 columns for icon, 1 column for delete button
- **Features**: 3 columns for name, 3 columns for icon, 5 columns for description, 1 column for delete button
- **Technical Details**: 5 columns for title, 6 columns for description, 1 column for delete button

The console errors should be resolved, and you can now delete individual entries from each section.

Fixed the issue. Changes:

1. **Removed the `required` attribute** from the file input — this was causing browser validation
2. **Added `novalidate` attribute** to the image upload form — prevents browser validation on that form
3. **Added JavaScript validation** in the `uploadImage` function — validates that a file is selected before uploading (only when clicking the Upload button)

Now when you click "Save Project", the browser won't validate the image upload form. The image upload form is separate and only validates when you click its own "Upload" button.

You can save projects without images, and the validation message will only appear if you try to upload an image without selecting a file.

Adding JavaScript to format JSON on load and when the button is clicked:


---

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="search_replace">

<details><summary>Tool use: **code_edit** • Edit file: /var/www/projectmanager.test/github_v2/admin/templates/side-projects/side_project_edit.html</summary>

**Chunk 1**
Lines added: 48, lines removed: undefined

```diff
@@ -640,4 +640,52 @@
      };
  }
+ 
+ // JSON formatting functionality
+ document.addEventListener(&#39;DOMContentLoaded&#39;, function() {
+     const statsTextarea = document.getElementById(&#39;stats&#39;);
+     const formatBtn = document.getElementById(&#39;format-json-btn&#39;);
+     
+     function formatJSON(textarea) {
+         const value = textarea.value.trim();
+         if (!value) return;
+         
+         try {
+             // Parse and stringify with indentation
+             const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
+             const formatted = JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2);
+             textarea.value = formatted;
+             
+             // Show success feedback
+             const originalText = formatBtn.innerHTML;
+             formatBtn.innerHTML = &#39;&lt;i class=&quot;fas fa-check mr-1&quot;&gt;&lt;/i&gt;Formatted!&#39;;
+             formatBtn.classList.add(&#39;text-green-600&#39;);
+             setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+                 formatBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                 formatBtn.classList.remove(&#39;text-green-600&#39;);
+             }, 2000);
+         } catch (error) {
+             // Show error feedback
+             const originalText = formatBtn.innerHTML;
+             formatBtn.innerHTML = &#39;&lt;i class=&quot;fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1&quot;&gt;&lt;/i&gt;Invalid JSON&#39;;
+             formatBtn.classList.add(&#39;text-red-600&#39;);
+             setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+                 formatBtn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                 formatBtn.classList.remove(&#39;text-red-600&#39;);
+             }, 2000);
+         }
+     }
+     
+     // Format on button click
+     if (formatBtn &amp;&amp; statsTextarea) {
+         formatBtn.addEventListener(&#39;click&#39;, function() {
+             formatJSON(statsTextarea);
+         });
+         
+         // Auto-format on page load if there&#39;s content
+         if (statsTextarea.value.trim()) {
+             formatJSON(statsTextarea);
+         }
+     }
+ });
  &lt;/script&gt;
  {% endblock %}
```

Fixed the API endpoint. The issue was that `sqlite3.Row` objects weren't being converted to dictionaries before JSON serialization, which can cause errors.

**Changes made:**
1. **Converted all Row objects to dictionaries** — All database results are now converted using `[dict(row) for row in rows]` before being used
2. **Used `.get()` method** — Switched to `.get()` for safer dictionary access with fallback values
3. **Enhanced error handling** — Added traceback to error responses for easier debugging

The API endpoint should now return valid JSON. If you still see the error, check:

1. **Server is running** — Ensure the FastAPI admin server is running
2. **Correct URL** — The frontend calls `/api/side-projects`; verify it matches your server URL
3. **CORS** — If the frontend is on a different origin, you may need CORS headers

Try refreshing the page. If the error persists, check the browser console and network tab to see the exact response from the API endpoint.

```diff
+ PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
+ 
+ -- Magento Module Categories (Production, In Development, Future Plans, etc.)
+ CREATE TABLE magento_module_categories (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   code            TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,   -- e.g., &quot;production&quot;, &quot;in-development&quot;, &quot;future-plans&quot;
+   label           TEXT NOT NULL,          -- display name
+   description     TEXT,
+   color           TEXT,                   -- color code for UI (e.g., &quot;blue&quot;, &quot;red&quot;, &quot;green&quot;)
+   icon            TEXT,                   -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+   created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+   updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ -- Seed initial categories
+ INSERT INTO magento_module_categories (code, label, description, color, icon, display_order) VALUES
+ (&#39;production&#39;, &#39;Production&#39;, &#39;Modules currently in production&#39;, &#39;green&#39;, &#39;fas fa-check-circle&#39;, 1),
+ (&#39;in-development&#39;, &#39;In Development&#39;, &#39;Modules currently being developed&#39;, &#39;orange&#39;, &#39;fas fa-code&#39;, 2),
+ (&#39;future-plans&#39;, &#39;Future Plans&#39;, &#39;Planned modules for future development&#39;, &#39;blue&#39;, &#39;fas fa-lightbulb&#39;, 3);
+ 
+ -- Magento Modules table
+ CREATE TABLE magento_modules (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   category_id     INTEGER REFERENCES magento_module_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
+   
+   title           TEXT NOT NULL,
+   slug            TEXT UNIQUE,
+   version         TEXT,                  -- e.g., &quot;v1.0.2&quot;
+   
+   description     TEXT,                  -- main description
+   
+   status          TEXT DEFAULT &#39;in development&#39;,  -- production, in development, future plans
+   metrics         TEXT,                  -- e.g., &quot;Multi-platform&quot;, &quot;50+ Scripts&quot;, &quot;Enterprise-grade&quot;
+   
+   posted_date     TEXT,                  -- when module was first posted
+   revised_date    TEXT,                  -- when module was last revised/updated
+   
+   -- Module statistics (stored as JSON)
+   stats           TEXT,                  -- JSON object with stats like {platforms: &quot;3&quot;, features: &quot;25+&quot;}
+   
+   created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;)),
+   updated_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime(&#39;now&#39;))
+ );
+ 
+ -- Technologies used in modules (many-to-many)
+ CREATE TABLE magento_module_technologies (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   module_id       INTEGER REFERENCES magento_modules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   name            TEXT NOT NULL,
+   icon            TEXT,                  -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Features of modules (many-to-many)
+ CREATE TABLE magento_module_features (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   module_id       INTEGER REFERENCES magento_modules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   name            TEXT NOT NULL,
+   description     TEXT,
+   icon            TEXT,                  -- Font Awesome icon class
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Technical details for modules
+ CREATE TABLE magento_module_technical_details (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   module_id       INTEGER REFERENCES magento_modules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   title           TEXT NOT NULL,
+   description     TEXT NOT NULL,
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Gallery images for modules
+ CREATE TABLE magento_module_images (
+   id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+   module_id       INTEGER REFERENCES magento_modules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+   url             TEXT NOT NULL,         -- e.g., &quot;/assets/images/magento/...&quot;
+   alt             TEXT,
+   width           INTEGER,
+   height          INTEGER,
+   is_cover        INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
+   display_order   INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+ );
+ 
+ -- Indexes
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_modules_category ON magento_modules(category_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_modules_slug ON magento_modules(slug);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_modules_status ON magento_modules(status);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_modules_posted_date ON magento_modules(posted_date);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_modules_revised_date ON magento_modules(revised_date);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_module_technologies_module ON magento_module_technologies(module_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_module_features_module ON magento_module_features(module_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_module_technical_details_module ON magento_module_technical_details(module_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_module_images_module ON magento_module_images(module_id);
+ CREATE INDEX idx_magento_module_categories_display_order ON magento_module_categories(display_order);
+
```

```diff
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/magento/images/upload&quot;)
+ def magento_module_image_upload(
+     module_id: int = Form(...),
+     file: UploadFile = File(...),
+     is_cover: bool = Form(False),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     if not file.filename:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=&quot;No file provided&quot;)
+     
+     ext = Path(file.filename).suffix.lower()
+     if ext not in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f&quot;Unsupported image format: {ext}&quot;)
+     
+     module_img_dir = MAGENTO_IMG_ROOT / str(module_id)
+     module_img_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+     
+     safe_filename = secrets.token_urlsafe(8) + ext
+     file_path = module_img_dir / safe_filename
+     url = f&quot;/assets/images/magento/{module_id}/{safe_filename}&quot;
+     
+     with file_path.open(&quot;wb&quot;) as f:
+         content = file.file.read()
+         f.write(content)
+     
+     with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+         # If setting as cover, unset all other cover images for this module
+         if is_cover:
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 UPDATE magento_module_images SET is_cover = 0 WHERE module_id = ?
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id,))
+         
+         max_order = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) FROM magento_module_images WHERE module_id = ?
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id,)).fetchone()[0]
+         
+         conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             INSERT INTO magento_module_images (module_id, url, alt, is_cover, display_order)
+             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id, url, file.filename, 1 if is_cover else 0, max_order + 1))
+         conn.commit()
+     
+     return RedirectResponse(url=f&quot;/admin/magento/{module_id}&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/magento/images/{image_id}/set-cover&quot;)
+ def magento_module_image_set_cover(
+     image_id: int,
+     is_cover: str = Form(&quot;true&quot;),
+ ) -&gt; JSONResponse:
+     with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+         # Get module_id from image
+         image = conn.execute(
+             &quot;SELECT module_id FROM magento_module_images WHERE id = ?&quot;, (image_id,)
+         ).fetchone()
+         if not image:
+             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=&quot;Image not found&quot;)
+         
+         module_id = image[&quot;module_id&quot;]
+         
+         # Unset all other cover images for this module
+         conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             UPDATE magento_module_images SET is_cover = 0 WHERE module_id = ?
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id,))
+         
+         # Set this image as cover
+         conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             UPDATE magento_module_images SET is_cover = 1 WHERE id = ?
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (image_id,))
+         conn.commit()
+     
+     return JSONResponse(content={&quot;success&quot;: True})
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/magento/images/{image_id}/delete&quot;)
+ def magento_module_image_delete(image_id: int) -&gt; JSONResponse:
+     with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+         # Get image info before deleting
+         image = conn.execute(
+             &quot;SELECT url, module_id FROM magento_module_images WHERE id = ?&quot;, (image_id,)
+         ).fetchone()
+         if not image:
+             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=&quot;Image not found&quot;)
+         
+         # Delete from database
+         conn.execute(&quot;DELETE FROM magento_module_images WHERE id = ?&quot;, (image_id,))
+         conn.commit()
+         
+         # Delete file if it exists
+         if image[&quot;url&quot;]:
+             # Extract path from URL (e.g., &quot;/assets/images/magento/1/abc123.jpg&quot;)
+             url_path = image[&quot;url&quot;].lstrip(&quot;/&quot;)
+             file_path = ROOT / url_path
+             if file_path.exists() and file_path.is_file():
+                 try:
+                     file_path.unlink()
+                 except Exception:
+                     pass  # Continue even if file deletion fails
+     
+     return JSONResponse(content={&quot;success&quot;: True})
+ 
+

+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/magento/categories/update&quot;)
+ def magento_module_category_update(
+     category_id: str = Form(...),
+     code: str = Form(...),
+     label: str = Form(...),
+     description: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     color: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     icon: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     display_order: int = Form(0),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     pk = _optional_int(category_id)
+     if pk is None:
+         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=&quot;Invalid category id.&quot;)
+     with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+         try:
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 UPDATE magento_module_categories 
+                 SET code = ?, label = ?, description = ?, color = ?, icon = ?, display_order = ?
+                 WHERE id = ?
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (
+                 code.strip(),
+                 label.strip(),
+                 description.strip(),
+                 color.strip(),
+                 icon.strip(),
+                 display_order,
+                 pk,
+             ))
+             conn.commit()
+         except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
+             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f&quot;Category code &#39;{code}&#39; already exists&quot;) from exc
+     return RedirectResponse(url=&quot;/admin/magento/categories&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/admin/magento/categories/{category_id}&quot;)
+ def magento_module_category_edit(request: Request, category_id: int) -&gt; Any:
+     with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+         category = conn.execute(
+             &quot;SELECT * FROM magento_module_categories WHERE id = ?&quot;, (category_id,)
+         ).fetchone()
+         if not category:
+             raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=&quot;Category not found&quot;)
+     return templates.TemplateResponse(
+         &quot;magento/magento_module_category_edit.html&quot;,
+         {&quot;request&quot;: request, &quot;category&quot;: category},
+     )
+ 
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/api/magento-modules&quot;)
+ def api_magento_modules() -&gt; JSONResponse:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;API endpoint to fetch all magento modules for frontend&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     try:
+         with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+             # Get categories - convert Row objects to dicts
+             categories_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT id, code, label, color, icon, display_order
+                 FROM magento_module_categories
+                 ORDER BY display_order, label
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             categories = [dict(row) for row in categories_rows]
+             
+             # Get modules with category info - convert Row objects to dicts
+             modules_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 SELECT 
+                     mm.*,
+                     c.code AS category_code,
+                     c.label AS category_label,
+                     c.color AS category_color,
+                     c.icon AS category_icon
+                 FROM magento_modules mm
+                 LEFT JOIN magento_module_categories c ON mm.category_id = c.id
+                 ORDER BY mm.revised_date DESC, mm.posted_date DESC, mm.id DESC
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;).fetchall()
+             modules = [dict(row) for row in modules_rows]
+             
+             # Build modules list with related data
+             modules_list = []
+             for module in modules:
+                 # Get technologies - convert Row objects to dicts
+                 technologies_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT name, icon FROM magento_module_technologies
+                     WHERE module_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, name
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 technologies = [dict(row) for row in technologies_rows]
+                 
+                 # Get features - convert Row objects to dicts
+                 features_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT name, description, icon FROM magento_module_features
+                     WHERE module_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, name
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 features = [dict(row) for row in features_rows]
+                 
+                 # Get technical details - convert Row objects to dicts
+                 technical_details_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT title, description FROM magento_module_technical_details
+                     WHERE module_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, title
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 technical_details = [dict(row) for row in technical_details_rows]
+                 
+                 # Get images - convert Row objects to dicts
+                 images_rows = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                     SELECT url, alt FROM magento_module_images
+                     WHERE module_id = ? ORDER BY display_order, id
+                 &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module[&quot;id&quot;],)).fetchall()
+                 images = [dict(row) for row in images_rows]
+                 
+                 # Parse stats JSON
+                 stats = {}
+                 if module.get(&quot;stats&quot;):
+                     try:
+                         stats = json.loads(module[&quot;stats&quot;])
+                     except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                         stats = {}
+                 
+                 modules_list.append({
+                     &quot;id&quot;: module[&quot;id&quot;],
+                     &quot;name&quot;: module[&quot;title&quot;],
+                     &quot;version&quot;: module.get(&quot;version&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;category&quot;: module.get(&quot;category_label&quot;) or &quot;Uncategorized&quot;,
+                     &quot;category_code&quot;: module.get(&quot;category_code&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;status&quot;: module.get(&quot;status&quot;) or &quot;in development&quot;,
+                     &quot;lastUpdated&quot;: module.get(&quot;revised_date&quot;) or module.get(&quot;posted_date&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;description&quot;: module.get(&quot;description&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;metrics&quot;: module.get(&quot;metrics&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                     &quot;technologies&quot;: [{&quot;name&quot;: t.get(&quot;name&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, &quot;icon&quot;: t.get(&quot;icon&quot;) or &quot;&quot;} for t in technologies],
+                     &quot;features&quot;: [{&quot;name&quot;: f.get(&quot;name&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, &quot;icon&quot;: f.get(&quot;icon&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, &quot;description&quot;: f.get(&quot;description&quot;) or &quot;&quot;} for f in features],
+                     &quot;technicalDetails&quot;: [{&quot;title&quot;: td.get(&quot;title&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, &quot;description&quot;: td.get(&quot;description&quot;) or &quot;&quot;} for td in technical_details],
+                     &quot;stats&quot;: stats,
+                     &quot;gallery&quot;: [{&quot;url&quot;: img.get(&quot;url&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, &quot;alt&quot;: img.get(&quot;alt&quot;) or &quot;&quot;} for img in images]
+                 })
+             
+             # Group modules by category code
+             modules_by_category = {}
+             for module in modules_list:
+                 cat_code = module[&quot;category_code&quot;] or &quot;uncategorized&quot;
+                 if cat_code not in modules_by_category:
+                     modules_by_category[cat_code] = []
+                 modules_by_category[cat_code].append(module)
+             
+             # Build categories list
+             categories_list = [{
+                 &quot;code&quot;: cat.get(&quot;code&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;label&quot;: cat.get(&quot;label&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;color&quot;: cat.get(&quot;color&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;icon&quot;: cat.get(&quot;icon&quot;) or &quot;&quot;,
+                 &quot;count&quot;: len(modules_by_category.get(cat.get(&quot;code&quot;) or &quot;&quot;, []))
+             } for cat in categories]
+         
+         return JSONResponse(content={
+             &quot;categories&quot;: categories_list,
+             &quot;modules&quot;: modules_by_category
+         })
+     except Exception as e:
+         import traceback
+         error_trace = traceback.format_exc()
+         return JSONResponse(content={&quot;categories&quot;: [], &quot;modules&quot;: {}, &quot;error&quot;: str(e), &quot;traceback&quot;: error_trace}, status_code=500)
+ 
  
```

</details>

</tool-use>

```diff
+                     return Math.ceil(this.filteredModules.length / this.itemsPerPage);
```

```diff
-                     return Math.ceil(this.filteredModules.length / this.itemsPerPage);

-                 get paginatedModules() {

-                     const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.itemsPerPage;
-                     const end = start + this.itemsPerPage;
-                     return arr.slice(start, end);
```

## Completed tasks

1. **Database schema** — Created `magento/schema.sql` with tables for modules, categories, technologies, features, technical details, and images
2. **Backend routes** — Added routes in `admin/app.py`:
   - Module list, edit, save
   - Category management
   - Image upload/delete/set cover
   - API endpoint `/api/magento-modules`
3. **Admin templates** — Created templates in `admin/templates/magento/`:
   - `magento_modules_list.html` — Grid listing with pagination
   - `magento_module_edit.html` — Edit form (similar to side-projects)
   - `magento_module_categories_list.html` — Category management
   - `magento_module_category_edit.html` — Category edit form
4. **Sidebar** — Added "Magento" section to the admin sidebar with links to modules and categories
5. **Frontend** — Updated `magento.html` to:
   - Fetch data from `/api/magento-modules`
   - Dynamically render categories and modules
   - Display modules in a grid with pagination
   - Show module details in a modal

The Magento Modules section is separate from Side Projects, with its own database, templates, and routes. The structure matches Side Projects, adapted for Magento modules (including a version field and status options: Production, In Development, Future Plans).

You can now:
- Access the Magento section from the admin sidebar
- Manage Magento module categories
- Create and edit Magento modules
- Upload images for modules
- View modules on the frontend `magento.html` page

The frontend will fetch data from the API when you add modules through the admin panel.

Fixed the issue. The templates were using `/admin/magento-modules/categories/` instead of `/admin/magento/categories/`, and there was no GET route for the new category form.

**Changes made:**

1. **Fixed URLs in templates** — Changed all instances of `/admin/magento-modules/categories/` to `/admin/magento/categories/` in:
   - `magento_module_categories_list.html`
   - `magento_module_category_edit.html`

2. **Added GET route for new category** — Added `@app.get("/admin/magento/categories/new")` to display the new category form (similar to how side-projects works).

Category editing should work now. The "Edit" link will go to `/admin/magento/categories/{category_id}` and the "New Category" button will go to `/admin/magento/categories/new`.

```diff
      return JSONResponse(content={&quot;success&quot;: True})
  
+ 
+ @app.get(&quot;/admin/side-projects/images/browse&quot;)
+ def side_project_images_browse() -&gt; JSONResponse:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;List all available images from assets/images/projects directory&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     images = []
+     projects_dir = ROOT / &quot;assets&quot; / &quot;images&quot; / &quot;projects&quot;
+     
+     if projects_dir.exists() and projects_dir.is_dir():
+         # Scan all subdirectories recursively
+         for item in projects_dir.rglob(&quot;*&quot;):
+             if item.is_file() and item.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
+                 # Get relative path from projects directory
+                 relative_path = item.relative_to(ROOT / &quot;assets&quot; / &quot;images&quot;)
+                 url = f&quot;/assets/images/{relative_path.as_posix()}&quot;
+                 images.append({
+                     &quot;url&quot;: url,
+                     &quot;filename&quot;: item.name,
+                     &quot;path&quot;: str(relative_path),
+                     &quot;size&quot;: item.stat().st_size
+                 })
+     
+     # Sort by filename
+     images.sort(key=lambda x: x[&quot;filename&quot;].lower())
+     
+     return JSONResponse(content={&quot;images&quot;: images})
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/side-projects/images/add-existing&quot;)
+ def side_project_image_add_existing(
+     project_id: int = Form(...),
+     url: str = Form(...),
+     alt: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     is_cover: bool = Form(False),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Add an existing image from the file system to a project&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     with get_side_projects_conn() as conn:
+         # If setting as cover, unset all other cover images for this project
+         if is_cover:
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 UPDATE side_project_images SET is_cover = 0 WHERE project_id = ?
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id,))
+         
+         max_order = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) FROM side_project_images WHERE project_id = ?
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id,)).fetchone()[0]
+         
+         conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             INSERT INTO side_project_images (project_id, url, alt, is_cover, display_order)
+             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (project_id, url, alt.strip(), 1 if is_cover else 0, max_order + 1))
+         conn.commit()
+     
+     return RedirectResponse(url=f&quot;/admin/side-projects/{project_id}&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
  
  @app.post(&quot;/admin/side-projects/categories/new&quot;)
```

```diff
+     # Sort by filename
+     images.sort(key=lambda x: x[&quot;filename&quot;].lower())
+     
+     return JSONResponse(content={&quot;images&quot;: images})
+ 
+ 
+ @app.post(&quot;/admin/magento/images/add-existing&quot;)
+ def magento_module_image_add_existing(
+     module_id: int = Form(...),
+     url: str = Form(...),
+     alt: str = Form(&quot;&quot;),
+     is_cover: bool = Form(False),
+ ) -&gt; RedirectResponse:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;Add an existing image from the file system to a module&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     with get_magento_conn() as conn:
+         # If setting as cover, unset all other cover images for this module
+         if is_cover:
+             conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+                 UPDATE magento_module_images SET is_cover = 0 WHERE module_id = ?
+             &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id,))
+         
+         max_order = conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) FROM magento_module_images WHERE module_id = ?
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id,)).fetchone()[0]
+         
+         conn.execute(&quot;&quot;&quot;
+             INSERT INTO magento_module_images (module_id, url, alt, is_cover, display_order)
+             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;, (module_id, url, alt.strip(), 1 if is_cover else 0, max_order + 1))
+         conn.commit()
+     
+     return RedirectResponse(url=f&quot;/admin/magento/{module_id}&quot;, status_code=303)
+ 
  
  @app.get(&quot;/admin/magento/categories/new&quot;)
```

## Summary

Added the ability to browse and select existing images from the file system for both Side Projects and Magento Modules.

### Backend Changes (`admin/app.py`):

1. **Added routes to browse images:**
   - `/admin/side-projects/images/browse` - Lists all images from `assets/images/projects/` and subdirectories
   - `/admin/magento/images/browse` - Lists all images from `assets/images/magento-modules/` and subdirectories

2. **Added routes to add existing images:**
   - `/admin/side-projects/images/add-existing` - Adds an existing image to a project
   - `/admin/magento/images/add-existing` - Adds an existing image to a module

### Frontend Changes:

1. **Side Projects Edit Form** (`admin/templates/side-projects/side_project_edit.html`):
   - Added "Browse Existing Images" button
   - Added image browser modal with grid view
   - Added ability to select an image, set alt text, and mark as cover image
   - Added JavaScript functions: `openImageBrowser()`, `closeImageBrowser()`, `addSelectedImage()`

2. **Magento Module Edit Form** (`admin/templates/magento/magento_module_edit.html`):
   - Same functionality as Side Projects
   - Updated to use Magento-specific endpoints and paths

### Features:

- Browse existing images: Click "Browse Existing Images" to see all images in the respective directories
- Visual selection: Click an image to select it (highlighted with blue border)
- Image details: Set alt text and mark as cover image before adding
- Recursive scanning: Scans all subdirectories for images
- Loading states: Shows loading spinner while fetching images
- Empty states: Shows message when no images are found

Both forms now support uploading new images and selecting existing images from the file system.

```diff
+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function sideProjectsTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         projects: initial.projects || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.projects.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedProjects() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.projects.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             // Show current page and 1 page on each side
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.projects.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.projects.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.projects.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
  {% endblock %}
```

```diff
+         modules: initial.modules || [],
+         init() {

+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.modules.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedModules() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.modules.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);

+         },

+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);

+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];

+             const pages = [];

+             // Show current page and 1 page on each side
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);

+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.modules.length) {

+         },
+     };
```

```diff
+                 &lt;template x-for=&quot;page in pageNumbers()&quot; :key=&quot;&#39;ref-page-&#39; + page&quot;&gt;

+                             :class=&quot;page === currentPage ? &#39;border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700&#39; : &#39;border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100&#39;&quot; 
+                             @click=&quot;goToPage(page)&quot; 
+                             x-text=&quot;page&quot;&gt;&lt;/button&gt;
+                 &lt;/template&gt;
+                 &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40&quot; @click=&quot;nextPage&quot; :disabled=&quot;currentPage === totalPages()&quot;&gt;Next&lt;/button&gt;
```

```diff
+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function referencesTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         references: initial.references || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.references.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedReferences() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.references.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             // Show current page and 1 page on each side
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.references.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.references.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.references.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
  {% endblock %}
```

```diff
                  return list;
              },
+             totalPages() {
+                 const total = this.filteredProjects.length;
+                 return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+             },
+             paginatedProjects() {
+                 const filtered = this.filteredProjects;
+                 const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+                 return filtered.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+             },
+             goToPage(page) {
+                 const total = this.totalPages();
+                 this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+             },
+             prevPage() {
+                 this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+             },
+             nextPage() {
+                 this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+             },
+             pageNumbers() {
+                 const total = this.totalPages();
+                 if (total === 0) return [];
+                 if (total === 1) return [1];
+                 
+                 const current = this.currentPage;
+                 const pages = [];
+                 
+                 // Show current page and 1 page on each side
+                 const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+                 const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+                 
+                 for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                     pages.push(i);
+                 }
+                 
+                 return pages;
+             },
+             rangeSummary() {
+                 const filtered = this.filteredProjects;
+                 if (!filtered.length) {
+                     return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+                 }
+                 const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+                 const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, filtered.length);
+                 return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${filtered.length} items&#96;;
+             },
          };
      }
```

## Summary

Updated all grid listing pages to be full-width, responsive, and use standardized pagination.

### Changes Made:

1. **Full-width responsive tables:**
   - Wrapped tables with `overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6` for full-width scrolling
   - Changed `min-w-full` to `w-full` for proper width handling

2. **Responsive column hiding:**
   - Less important columns hide on smaller screens using Tailwind classes (`hidden sm:table-cell`, `hidden md:table-cell`, `hidden lg:table-cell`, `hidden xl:table-cell`)
   - Important info remains visible on mobile

3. **Standardized pagination:**
   - Left: Per Page dropdown with options [10, 20, 30, 50, 100]
   - Middle: "Showing ##-## of ## items"
   - Right: Prev/Next buttons + page numbers (current page highlighted, 1 page before/after if available)

4. **Pages updated:**
   - ✅ Clients — Updated to standard format
   - ✅ Portfolio — Added pagination and made responsive
   - ✅ Documents — Added pagination and made responsive
   - ✅ References — Added pagination and made responsive
   - ✅ Side Projects — Added pagination and made responsive
   - ✅ Magento Modules — Added pagination and made responsive
   - ✅ Tech Skill Categories — Updated to standard format
   - ✅ Tech Skills — Updated page number display (current ± 1 instead of ± 2)

All pages now have consistent styling, responsive behavior, and standardized pagination matching the Tech Skills page format.

Fixed the issue. The backend routes returned `sqlite3.Row` objects, which can't be serialized to JSON with Jinja2's `tojson` filter. Converted them to dictionaries before passing to the templates.

**Changes made:**

1. **`/admin/magento`** — Convert `modules_rows` to dictionaries
2. **`/admin/side-projects`** — Convert `projects_rows` to dictionaries
3. **`/admin/documents`** — Convert `documents_rows` to dictionaries

All three routes now convert Row objects to dictionaries using `[dict(row) for row in rows]` before passing them to the templates, matching the pattern used in the edit pages.

The pages should now load without internal errors. The data will serialize correctly for Alpine.js pagination.

```diff
+                             @click=&quot;goToPage(page)&quot;

+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function magentoCategoriesTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         categories: initial.categories || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.categories.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedCategories() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.categories.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             // Show current page and 1 page on each side
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.categories.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.categories.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.categories.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
  {% endblock %}
```

```diff
+ &lt;script&gt;
+ function sideProjectCategoriesTable(initial) {
+     return {
+         perPageOptions: [10, 20, 30, 50, 100],
+         perPage: 10,
+         currentPage: 1,
+         categories: initial.categories || [],
+         init() {
+             this.$watch(&#39;perPage&#39;, () =&gt; { this.currentPage = 1; });
+         },
+         totalPages() {
+             const total = this.categories.length;
+             return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / this.perPage));
+         },
+         paginatedCategories() {
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage;
+             return this.categories.slice(start, start + this.perPage);
+         },
+         goToPage(page) {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             this.currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(page, 1), total);
+         },
+         prevPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage - 1);
+         },
+         nextPage() {
+             this.goToPage(this.currentPage + 1);
+         },
+         pageNumbers() {
+             const total = this.totalPages();
+             if (total === 0) return [];
+             if (total === 1) return [1];
+             
+             const current = this.currentPage;
+             const pages = [];
+             
+             // Show current page and 1 page on each side
+             const start = Math.max(1, current - 1);
+             const end = Math.min(total, current + 1);
+             
+             for (let i = start; i &lt;= end; i++) {
+                 pages.push(i);
+             }
+             
+             return pages;
+         },
+         rangeSummary() {
+             if (!this.categories.length) {
+                 return &#39;Showing 0 items&#39;;
+             }
+             const start = (this.currentPage - 1) * this.perPage + 1;
+             const end = Math.min(start + this.perPage - 1, this.categories.length);
+             return &#96;Showing ${start}-${end} of ${this.categories.length} items&#96;;
+         },
+     };
+ }
+ &lt;/script&gt;
  {% endblock %}
```
